description: This file contains profiling functions for Bluetooth Low Energy link layer (LLL) performance measurement, including timestamp sampling, latency calculation, and event generation for profiling purposes.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends profiling data encapsulated in a node_rx_pdu, calculating latency and CPU time metrics, and generating profiling events if changes are detected.

methods.name: sample
methods.description: Samples the current radio timer and stores the timestamp.

methods.name: delta
methods.description: Calculates the difference between the current radio timer and a previous timestamp, updating CPU time metrics if the delta is within valid range.
